tagline.en: MultiWorld — a multi-agent, interactive video world model exploring worlds where more than one agent acts at once.
tagline.zh: MultiWorld——一个多智能体、交互式的视频世界模型，探索多个智能体同时行动的世界。

en: MultiWorld is an interactive video world model focused on multi-agent settings — worlds where more than one agent can act, illustrated by its 「It Takes Two」 configuration. It generates interactive, game-like video rather than acting as a robot control policy.

In WorldFoundry the MultiWorld It-Takes-Two pipeline is registered as the model-zoo entry with an in-tree wrapper, so you drive it through the shared interface for interactive and multi-agent video generation.
Full generation depends on additional runtime dependencies and checkpoints, which you stage locally before running end to end.
zh: MultiWorld 是一个交互式视频世界模型，聚焦多智能体场景——即多个智能体可同时行动的世界，其「It Takes Two」配置正体现了这一点。它生成交互式、类游戏的视频，而非充当机器人控制策略。
在 WorldFoundry 中，MultiWorld 的 It-Takes-Two pipeline 已作为 model-zoo 条目注册并配有内置封装，你可通过统一接口驱动它，用于交互式与多智能体视频生成。
完整生成依赖额外的运行时依赖与 checkpoint，需要你在端到端运行前于本地准备好。

whenToUse.en: Use MultiWorld when your scenario involves multiple interacting agents in a generated, game-like world rather than a single controllable stream.
whenToUse.zh: 当你的场景涉及在生成的类游戏世界中有多个相互作用的智能体，而非单一可控流时，可以使用 MultiWorld。

notFor.en: It's a video world model, not a control policy. Full generation is gated on extra dependencies and checkpoints you provide locally.
notFor.zh: 它是视频世界模型，而非控制策略。完整生成需依赖你在本地提供的额外依赖与 checkpoint。

en: 「It Takes Two」 configuration for more than one acting agent
Registered in-tree through the shared pipeline
Full generation requires extra dependencies and checkpoints staged locally
zh: 多智能体、交互式视频世界模型
面向多个行动智能体的「It Takes Two」配置
通过统一 pipeline 以内置方式注册
完整生成需在本地准备额外依赖与 checkpoint
